column8: The ability to do CRM like actions within the system and do SMS messaging. Itlooked like it an application that would provide what needed currently, as well as the type of features that we wanted to grow into.
column9: My business partner and did three video calls with Just call to discuss and review the application, see if it would work our needs and learn how to use it. We must have spent in total a bit more than a half of a day's work so that we could review that the application would solve our problems and learn how to use it to do so. Well, not long into our trial, they sent us this message: We are writing to inform you that your JustCall account has been permanently closed. Our systems has detected usage linked to your JustCall account that violates our Terms and Conditions. As a result, your JustCall account has been closed, and you will not have any access to our services. Please note that this decision is final. If you believe this action was taken in error, you may contact us at [email protected] to reconsider our action. Well,it was a pretty nasty message of itself, but we figured we would give justcall a chance to explain themselves and fix it. I explained to them that I was in the process of transitioning from one business service to a similar one, had reserved my domain name but the new web site is currently in development. We need a phone number to put on our new website for our new business before we can plop the web site down on the domain. I explained that to them, but apparently that wasn't good enough, and they told us to move on.
